meanings: To inspire, to make or render obligatory/necessary, settle a thing firmly, decree/ordain/pronounce a thing, to establish, be unavoidable, decide a thing judicially, necessitate a thing, wish good for someone, to be soft/yielding/crummy/easily broken, crumble or break into small bits, break into pieces, to be cheerful/brisk/lively/sprightly, cut or cut off a thing.

occurrences.verseArabic: وَإِنْ مِنْكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَقْضِيًّا
occurrences.verseTransliteration: Ve in minkum illâ vâriduhâ, kâne alâ rabbike hatmen makdıyyâ(makdıyyen).
occurrences.verseMeaning: İçinizden oraya uğramayacak hiç kimse yoktur. Bu, Rabbin üzerinde kesinleşmiş bir hükümdür.
